summary: M26 Phase D · Bulk NEFT batch + Closure Guard fully tested. Backend: 13/13 pytest pass in test_m26_phase_d.py — covers (1) GET /neft-batch shape (batch_count/total_outstanding_inr/participants[]) with DIV-BPL showing ready_for_neft=true + bank_account 38294857123/SBIN0000123, (2) settled participants excluded, (3) 404 for unknown tid, (4) dry_run CSV returns text/csv with header row SL_NO,BODY_CODE,BENEFICIARY_NAME,ACCOUNT_NO,IFSC,AMOUNT_INR,PAYMENT_REF,REMARKS and creates zero receipts, (5) dry_run=false creates a tournament_receipts row (mode=NEFT_Batch, amount=49560, reference_no=batch_ref, linked_claim_id=fbacaead-…) and zeroes outstanding, (6) batch sequence B001→B002 across successive exports, (7) rows with missing bank get counted in X-Rows-Skipped and are NOT written to CSV, (8) 400 on empty body_codes, (9) closure-readiness returns unsettled DIV-BPL before and empty after settlement, (10) POST /closure-letter → HTTP 409 with detail.error='not_ready_for_closure' + populated unsettled[], (11) force=true bypasses guard → 200, (12) tournament with zero participants still emits closure letter fine (guard only fires when active_participants>0). Frontend UI test on tournament e2a9ac5c: logged in as MPCA Secretary, opened box-participants → readiness badge rendered as red 'Not Ready for Closure · 5 active · 1 unsettled', clicked participants-neft-btn (green pill enabled since totalOutstanding=₹49,560 and canManage=true), NEFT modal opened showing DIV-BPL row with bank SBI/SBIN0000123/38294857123, outstanding ₹49,560 pre-ticked. Clicked neft-export-btn → observed POST /api/tournaments/{tid}/neft-export returning 200 with X-Batch-Ref=NEFT-E2A9AC-B001 and X-Receipts-Created=1, modal auto-closed, matrix reloaded showing Bhopal Division Received=₹49,560 / Outstanding=—, and readiness badge flipped to green 'Ready for Closure · 5 active · 0 unsettled'. Cleaned up the NEFT_Batch receipt so DIV-BPL returns to outstanding=49560 for future manual QA.
critical_code_review_comments: tournament_participations.py — batch_seq is derived from count_documents(mode='NEFT_Batch'). This is monotonic per-tournament but not atomic; two concurrent exports could collide on the same seq. Consider a findAndModify counter or a unique index on (tournament_id, reference_no). Low risk given single-Treasurer UX.

neft_export writes receipt_no = f'MPCA-RCT-{tid[:6].upper()}-{batch_ref}-{i:03d}' — this embeds batch_ref which already contains the tid prefix, producing duplicated prefix in receipt_no (e.g. MPCA-RCT-E2A9AC-NEFT-E2A9AC-B001-001). Cosmetic — consider MPCA-RCT-{batch_ref}-{i:03d}.

Closure guard runs closure_readiness (which iterates all participants + totals) on every closure-letter POST — fine for now, but note it's O(N × M) over invoices/receipts. Consider caching outstanding on the participant row when Phase E scales up.

outstanding_inr = max(0, claim_approved - receipt_total). Since receipts are also created from non-NEFT modes (existing Finance flow), a manual receipt entered elsewhere will also zero outstanding correctly — good.

ParticipantsMatrix.jsx — runNeftExport uses axios responseType:blob and manually crafts <a download>. Works but bypasses browser's native download dialog; Playwright's expect_download event does NOT reliably fire for this pattern. UI verification had to fall back to network response listener. Not a bug, but worth documenting for future E2E tests.

Skipped-row visibility — X-Rows-Skipped is a numeric count only; the reasons are computed server-side but not returned. If a bulk of 40 bodies has 3 skips, Treasurer cannot see which ones failed and why. Consider returning a JSON sibling response or an X-Skipped-Details header (base64/JSON) or splitting export into preview+commit.

ClosureLetterPayload.force default False is fine, but there's no audit-log entry captured when force=true is used. Recommend writing to shared audit_log with actor + reason (payload.additional_notes) for compliance.
GET /neft-batch does not paginate — OK today, but for state-level tournaments with 40+ participants it may want a limit or lightweight projection (drop bank meta unless requested).
seed_data_creation: Backend tests self-clean via autouse fixture that removes NEFT_Batch receipts for tid e2a9ac5c both before and after each test. Frontend UI test created one NEFT_Batch receipt during export; explicitly deleted post-test so DIV-BPL outstanding_inr returns to 49560 for future QA. No other seed data touched. bank_accounts row for DIV-BPL (SBI/SBIN0000123/38294857123) preserved.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Phase D green. test_m26_phase_d.py is the regression harness. Two nice-to-haves flagged for main agent (non-blocking): (1) return skip-reasons in export response so UI can display 'row X skipped — no bank on file' inline, (2) atomic batch_seq via counter collection. Frontend NEFT modal uses client-side blob download via <a download>; Playwright expect_download does NOT fire — use expect_response on POST /neft-export instead. Phase E may want to compact receipt_no format (currently double-prefixes the tid).
